p: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out: Thus spoke Jehu to Baasha in the Name of the Lord.
thy house like the house of: Meaning, the house of Baasha.
by the hand of the prophet: That is, the prophet did his message.
drinking himself drunk in the house: The Chaldee text has this, "Drinking till he was drunk in the temple of Arza the idol by his house in Tirzah".
prophet: Both Hanani his father and he were prophets.
against Gibbethon: The siege had continued from the time of Nadab Jeroboam's son.
half of the people followed Tibni: That is, the people who were not at the siege of Gibbethon: for there they had chosen Omri.
worse than all that were before: For such is the nature of idolatry, that the superstition of it daily increases, and the older it is, the more abominable it is before God and his Church.
Samaria: He was the first king that was buried in Samaria, after that the kings house was burnt in Tirzah.
to wife Jezebel the daughter of: By whose influence he fell into wicked and strange idolatry and cruel persecution.
